description: A complete parametric brief: a circle whose radius is driven by a slider; decomposition, discovery, two adds and a wire.
userPrompt: Create a circle on the XY plane at the origin whose radius is driven by a number slider. Inputs: the radius, from 1 to 10 m (my numbers). Rule: the circle is always centred on the origin. Principle: a one-parameter column footprint. Evaluation: keep the footprint area at or below 50 m2; I will judge it by reading the area. Go ahead and build it.
